subject: gk
question: The fundamental duties were added in the Indian Constitution on the recommendation of the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Swaran Singh Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Swaran Singh Committee's **recommendations resulted in the incorporation of** fundamental duties into the Indian Constitution in 1976**.
 
• Through the** 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act,** a new section, Part IVA, was introduced, outlining a list of ten fundamental duties. In 2002, the 86th Constitutional Amendment further augmented these duties by adding an 11th one.
 
• The idea of fundamental duties draws from the Soviet Constitution, which is now part of Russia. These duties are deeply rooted in Indian tradition, mythology, religions, and cultural practices, encapsulating essential tasks integral to the Indian way of life.
 
• In the case of Ranganath Mishra vs. Union of India (2003), the highest court underscored the significance of fundamental duties, particularly in safeguarding the nation's rich heritage. Although not enforceable by law, the court stressed their crucial role in nation-building.
 
• All 11 fundamental duties are enshrined in Article 51-A of the Constitution, with one duty being "to uphold and protect the Sovereignty, Unity, and Integrity of India".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Sardar Swaran Singh,** an esteemed Indian politician, holds the distinction of being India's longest-serving union cabinet minister.
 
• During the national emergency in 1976, he chaired the committee tasked with studying the Constitution of India. Following the declaration of the emergency, Indira Gandhi appointed Sardar Swaran Singh to lead a committee aimed at assessing potential amendments to the constitution based on past experiences.
 
• The recommendations put forth by this committee led to significant changes to the Constitution, including modifications to the Preamble, as seen in the Forty-second Amendment of the Constitution of India, ratified in 1976 and enforced on 3 January 1977.
 
• In recognition of his contributions, he was honored with the Padma Vibhushan award, the second-highest civilian award bestowed by the Republic of India, in 1992.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee** was established by the Government of India on 16 January 1957, with the primary objective of evaluating the effectiveness of the Community Development Programme and the National Extension Service. Its mandate included recommending measures to enhance their operational efficiency.
 
• **The Bibek Debroy Committee** was constituted as a general council by the NDA government subsequent to assuming office in 2014.
 
• **The L. M. Singhvi Committee** was tasked with the revitalization of the Panchayati Raj institution, focusing on fostering democracy and promoting development initiatives.
